svg.title: The Jev funnel
svg.desc: Animated diagram. Items collected by code flow into Jev, which judges every one. Confident YES answers are handled in code, confident NO answers are dropped in code, and only the uncertain few go to Claude or a human for review. In one published test, 98% of 306 decisions cleared a 0.5 confidence gate automatically and were 100% accurate on that subset; the other 2% were escalated. Source: Greenberg, Jev vs Claude: Who Wins? (dev.to), one bounded 3-state task. The dots are illustrative.
svg.text: Code collects the items, Jev judges all of them, and only the uncertain band goes to Claude or a human.
98% of 306 decisions cleared a 0.5 gate automatically — 100% accurate on that subset
cleared the gate, handled in code
Dots illustrate the flow. Source: Greenberg, ‘Jev vs Claude: Who Wins?’ (dev.to), one bounded 3-state task.
